results.name: Algebra.IsEffective
results.source_text:
/-- For an `R`-algebra `S`, this asserts that the maps `algebraMap : R → S` and
`includeLeftSubRight R S : S → S ⊗[R] S` form an exact pair.
When `R` and `S` are commutative rings, this is true if and only if the inclusion
`im (algebraMap : R → S) → S` is an effective monomorphism in the category of commutative rings. -/
def IsEffective : Prop :=
  Function.Exact (Algebra.linearMap R S) (TensorProduct.includeLeftSubRight R S)
results.docstring:
For an `R`-algebra `S`, this asserts that the maps `algebraMap : R → S` and
`includeLeftSubRight R S : S → S ⊗[R] S` form an exact pair.
When `R` and `S` are commutative rings, this is true if and only if the inclusion
`im (algebraMap : R → S) → S` is an effective monomorphism in the category of commutative rings.

results.name: Ordnode.Valid'
results.source_text:
/-- The validity predicate for an `Ordnode` subtree. This asserts that the `size` fields are
correct, the tree is balanced, and the elements of the tree are organized according to the
ordering. This version of `Valid` also puts all elements in the tree in the interval `(lo, hi)`. -/
structure Valid' (lo : WithBot α) (t : Ordnode α) (hi : WithTop α) : Prop where
  ord : t.Bounded lo hi
  sz : t.Sized
  bal : t.Balanced
results.docstring:
The validity predicate for an `Ordnode` subtree. This asserts that the `size` fields are

results.name: Ordnode.Valid
results.source_text:
/-- The validity predicate for an `Ordnode` subtree. This asserts that the `size` fields are
correct, the tree is balanced, and the elements of the tree are organized according to the
ordering. -/
def Valid (t : Ordnode α) : Prop :=
  Valid' ⊥ t ⊤

results.name: Ordnode.Valid'.valid
results.source_text:
theorem Valid'.valid {t o₁ o₂} (h : @Valid' α _ o₁ t o₂) : Valid t :=
  ⟨h.1.weak, h.2, h.3⟩

results.name: ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.measurable_kernel_prodMk_left'
results.source_text:
theorem measurable_kernel_prodMk_left' [IsSFiniteKernel η] {s : Set (β × γ)} (hs : MeasurableSet s)
    (a : α) : Measurable fun b => η (a, b) (Prod.mk b ⁻¹' s) := by
  have (b : _) : Prod.mk b ⁻¹' s = {c | ((a, b), c) ∈ {p : (α × β) × γ | (p.1.2, p.2) ∈ s}} := rfl
  simp_rw [this]
  refine (measurable_kernel_prodMk_left ?_).comp measurable_prodMk_left
  exact (measurable_fst.snd.prodMk measurable_snd) hs

lemma isViable_iff_charges_mem_viableCharges_mem_liftCharges (x : Quanta) :
    IsViable x ↔ (∃ I, x.toCharges ∈ viableCharges I) ∧
      x ∈ Quanta.liftCharge x.toCharges ∧
      x.LinearAnomalyCancellation := by
  simp [Quanta.mem_liftCharge_iff, toCharges_qHd, toCharges_qHu]

    isViable_iff_charges_mem_viableCharges, ← FluxesFive.noExotics_iff_mem_elemsNoExotics,
    ← FluxesTen.noExotics_iff_mem_elemsNoExotics]
  aesop

results.name: Polynomial.cyclotomic'.monic
results.source_text:
/-- `cyclotomic' n R` is monic. -/
theorem cyclotomic'.monic (n : ℕ) (R : Type*) [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] :
    (cyclotomic' n R).Monic :=
  monic_prod_of_monic _ _ fun _ _ => monic_X_sub_C _

results.name: Polynomial.mul_modByMonic
results.source_text:
lemma mul_modByMonic (p₁ p₂ q : R[X]) : (p₁ * p₂) %ₘ q = (p₁ %ₘ q) * (p₂ %ₘ q) %ₘ q := by
  by_cases! h : ¬ q.Monic
  · simp [Polynomial.modByMonic_eq_of_not_monic _ h]
  apply Polynomial.modByMonic_eq_of_dvd_sub h
  have : p₁ * p₂ - p₁ %ₘ q * (p₂ %ₘ q) = (p₁ %ₘ q) * (p₂ - p₂ %ₘ q) + p₂ * (p₁ - p₁ %ₘ q) := by ring
  rw [this]
  apply dvd_add
  all_goals
  · apply dvd_mul_of_dvd_right
    simp [Polynomial.modByMonic_eq_sub_mul_div]

results.name: Polynomial.monic_X_pow_sub
results.source_text:
theorem monic_X_pow_sub {n : ℕ} (H : degree p < n) : Monic (X ^ n - p) := by
  simpa [sub_eq_add_neg] using monic_X_pow_add (show degree (-p) < n by rwa [← degree_neg p] at H)

results.name: Polynomial.monic_X_pow_sub_C
results.source_text:
/-- `X ^ n - a` is monic. -/
theorem monic_X_pow_sub_C {R : Type u} [Ring R] (a : R) {n : ℕ} (h : n ≠ 0) :
    (X ^ n - C a).Monic := by
  simpa only [map_neg, ← sub_eq_add_neg] using monic_X_pow_add_C (-a) h

results.name: Polynomial.monic_X_sub_C
results.source_text:
theorem monic_X_sub_C (x : R) : Monic (X - C x) := by
  simpa only [sub_eq_add_neg, C_neg] using monic_X_add_C (-x)

results.name: Polynomial.IsMonicOfDegree.sub
results.source_text:
lemma IsMonicOfDegree.sub {p q : R[X]} {n : ℕ} (hp : IsMonicOfDegree p n) (hq : q.natDegree < n) :
    IsMonicOfDegree (p - q) n := by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg]
  exact hp.add_right <| (natDegree_neg q) ▸ hq
